card.$description: Grouped cards on a page or the Settings sheet: 25.6pt in both themes. Plus or minus 2 pt; the corner is continuous (squircle).

cardSheet.$description: Grouped cards inside a bottom sheet: 23.9pt in both themes.

bubble.$description: The owner's message bubble: 23.9pt in both themes. Every corner is the same; no tail.

sheet.$description: Top corners of a bottom sheet: 35.8pt in both themes.

row.$description: Selected sidebar row: 13.7pt on a 47pt row.

menu.$description: Pull-down and context menus (iOS 26 glass): 17.1pt. The glass edge is soft, so plus or minus 4 pt.

field.$description: Pop-up select field: 10.2pt in light, where its rim reads.

capsule.$description: Fully round ends: the Talk and New chat pills, the send button, glass nav buttons, the model pill, badges, the search field, switches and day toggles.

base.$description: Every measured gap is a multiple of 4 pt within a pixel or two.

xs.$description: Gap between a row title and its subtitle.

sm.$description: Gap between controls in the composer's lower row.

md.$description: Gap between the composer's input line and its controls.

lg.$description: Screen margin: cards, the response and the composer start 16 pt from the screen edge; cards stack 16.5 pt apart in Settings.

xl.$description: Inset of text inside a card: section headers and card text start 20 pt inside the card's edge (Usage, Settings).

xxl.$description: Side margin of cards inside a bottom sheet: 23.5 pt from the screen edge.

screenMargin.$description: Left and right margin of cards, text and the composer.

cardPadding.$description: Horizontal padding inside a grouped card.

navButton.$description: Round glass buttons (sidebar, close, back, more): 44pt wide, 45pt tall with the rim's soft edge.

height.$description: The composer, two rows: the input line over the controls (+, model pill, microphone, Talk or send).

width.$description: The composer in a thread spans the screen less its margins; on a new chat it is wider (374pt).

control.$description: Round + and microphone buttons and the model pill inside the composer: one 36 pt height.

send.$description: The orange send button, a circle (36x36pt).

width.$description: The Talk pill, the composer's resting primary action.

pill.$description: Floating primary pill (New chat, New project, New session): 122.5x41pt.

button.$description: Full-width button at the bottom of a sheet (Share): 357x47pt.

row.$description: Settings row with an icon: the mean pitch of the 6 divider rows in rows.settings, divider to divider.

rowTwoLine.$description: Two-line row in a sheet (model name over a description): the mean pitch of the divider rows in rows.sheet, 68.75 pt, rounded to a point.

rowList.$description: Chats and Projects list row with a subtitle (no dividers).

selectedRow.$description: The selected sidebar row's fill: 296x47pt, 12 pt from the screen edge.

select.$description: Pop-up select field: 119.5x40.5pt dark, 123x39pt light, rim included; the height rounded to a point.

progress.$description: Usage meter track thickness (317x7.5pt, round ends).

bubbleMaxWidth.$description: The owner's bubble at three lines (312.5x96pt), right-aligned to the screen margin.

touchTarget.$description: Nav buttons, rows and the selected-row fill are 44 pt or more. Composer controls (36 pt), the Talk pill (35 pt), switches (27 pt) and badges (20.5 pt) are smaller and sit inside larger rows or the composer.

hairline.$description: Dividers between grouped rows and the pop-up select's rim: one device pixel at 2x.

sans.$description: The interface sans. Not determinable from pixels; its letterforms are not the iOS system face (a single-storey g, round dots), so the family is the product's own. Use the platform sans.

serif.$description: The serif of responses, greetings, the sidebar wordmark and promo titles. Not determinable from pixels; a book serif with bracketed serifs. Use the platform serif.

regular.$description: Body, rows, responses, subtitles. Judged by stroke width, not measured.

medium.$description: Pill labels (New chat, Add device) and badges. Judged by stroke width.

semibold.$description: Nav and sheet titles, the page heading, the Share and Talk labels. Judged by stroke width.

display.$description: Promo sheet title ('Give the gift of Claude'). Cap-height readings: 31pt.

titleSerif.$description: The sidebar wordmark and the new-chat greeting. Cap-height readings: 23pt, 24pt.

response.$description: Claude's responses in a thread: serif, on the page, with no bubble. Cap-height readings: 17pt.

headline.$description: Nav and sheet titles. Cap-height readings: 17pt, 18pt.

body.$description: The owner's bubble, settings rows, list titles, menu items, the composer, empty-state titles. Cap-height readings: 17pt.

pageHeading.$description: Heading at the top of a settings page ('Time and focus'). Cap-height readings: 16pt.

callout.$description: List subtitles, section headers, tool-step rows, pill labels, empty-state explanations, artifact titles, Appearance tile labels. Cap-height readings: 14pt, 15pt.

subheadline.$description: Setting subtitles, the disclaimer under a response, artifact dates, the Talk label. Cap-height readings: 13pt.

footnote.$description: Sheet row subtitles and helper text under a sheet card. Cap-height readings: 12pt.

caption.$description: Badge labels (Recommended, Beta, usage). Cap-height readings: 10pt.

notTokenised: iOS 26 glass (nav buttons, the composer, menus, the search bar, the Add device pill): blur and refraction come from the system material
Continuous (squircle) corners: DTCG has no value for corner smoothing
Motion and easing: stills only; the streaming response and the Talk mode were not captured
Shadows: none drawn in dark; light glass controls carry a faint soft shadow that was not measured
Line heights of titles and one-line labels: only multi-line blocks were measured

page.$description: New chat and chat threads; also bottom sheets and the Settings sheet, which use the same value.

list.$description: Pushed list and settings pages (Chats, Projects, Artifacts, Code, Time & focus): darker than the chat page in dark, the same as it in light.

sidebar.$description: The sidebar, which slides over the page from the left.

sheet.$description: Bottom sheets (Select model, Effort, Add to Chat) and the Settings sheet.

scrim.$description: Black at 20%: the new chat reads #F9F9F7 undimmed and #C7C7C7 under a sheet.

card.$description: Grouped cards in Settings and in sheets (sheet cards read the same).

userBubble.$description: The owner's message bubble. Claude's replies have no bubble.

glass.$description: The composer (glass), centre reading above the placeholder. The material tints with what is behind it. The box's dominant colour covers 67% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

control.$description: Controls inside the composer (+, model pill, microphone).

navGlass.$description: Round glass nav buttons, beside the icon. The box's dominant colour covers 73% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

menu.$description: Pull-down and context menus (glass). The box's dominant colour covers 34% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

selected.$description: The selected sidebar row. Not captured in light: filled from surface.control, the closest light grey fill.

search.$description: Search field once typing. Not captured in light: filled from surface.control.

dayToggle.$description: Day toggle circle, off. The reading includes the letter, so it is the dominant pixel. The box's dominant colour covers 80% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

emptyIcon.$description: Circle behind an empty-state icon: the card colour. Not captured in light: filled from surface.card, which it matches in dark.

divider.$description: Hairline between grouped rows, inset to the row text.

field.$description: Rim of a pop-up select field. The box's dominant colour covers 57% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

card.$description: Rim of an artifact card, which has no fill of its own. Not captured in light: filled from border.divider.

primary.$description: Row labels, titles, the owner's bubble, menu items. Readings in this role: #090909, #111110, #121211, #121212.

greeting.$description: The serif greeting on a new chat: softer than primary text.

secondary.$description: The account line, sidebar section headers, unchosen tile labels, badge labels. Readings: #51514F, #52504F.

tertiary.$description: Subtitles, section headers, tool-step rows, action icons, row values, empty-state lines. Readings: #787876, #797876, #7A7875, #7B7976, #7B7A78, #89898B.

footnote.$description: The disclaimer under a response and list subtitles.

disabled.$description: Title of a locked setting (Artifacts, required by code execution).

link.$description: Action text in a card (Add account, Give the gift of Claude).

selected.$description: Label of the chosen Appearance tile.

danger.$description: Destructive menu items (Delete): red text with a red icon, never a red fill.

onPrimary.$description: Label on the inverse primary pill (Talk, New chat, Share).

onAccent.$description: Arrow on the orange send button.

default.$description: The interactive blue: switches on, the chosen-model tick, the chosen Appearance tile, usage meters.

check.$description: Tick on the chosen item in a sheet.

brand.$description: Claude's spark above the greeting. The same in both themes.

send.$description: The send button once the composer has text. The same in both themes.

filter.$description: An active filter button (Archived), glass tinted orange. Not captured in light: the dark value is used, as the brand orange is the same in both themes.

caret.$description: Text caret in the composer: the only focus indicator seen (no ring). The box's dominant colour covers 75% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

bg.$description: The inverse primary pill (Talk, New chat, New project, Share): near-white in dark, near-black in light.

text.$description: Label on the inverse primary pill.

bg.$description: Round + and microphone buttons and the model pill inside the composer.

onDisabled.$description: Switch on, locked by another setting.

thumbDisabled.$description: Switch thumb, locked (grey in dark, white in light).

fill.$description: Usage meter fill. The same in both themes.

track.$description: Usage meter track: a deep blue in dark, a pale blue in light.

warningBg.$description: Amber badge that warns of higher usage ('5.5x or more usage'). Not captured in light: the dark value is used; the effort sheet was captured in dark only.

warningText.$description: Label on the amber usage badge. Not captured in light: the dark value is used; the effort sheet was captured in dark only.

danger.$description: Danger: red text on destructive items. No danger fill was seen.

warning.$description: Warning: the amber usage badge. No other warning state was seen.

notTokenised: Success colour: no success state was seen
